items.title: Viewer address bar that gets out of the way
items.text: In viewer panes the URL bar now slides in from the top and reserves its own space instead of floating over the page, so nothing at the top of the page gets covered or becomes unclickable. It only reveals when you deliberately move to the very top edge.

items.title: Browser-style URL completion
items.text: Typing a bare address in a viewer completes it like a browser omnibox (`cnn` → `https://cnn.com`), preserving ports and paths, and sending `localhost`/`127.0.0.1` to `http://`. Focusing the field selects the whole address for a quick retype.

items.title: Smooth banner collapse/expand
items.text: Toggling a pane banner open or closed now animates the card resize and cross-fades its content, while the terminal below reflows instantly instead of chasing the animation frame-by-frame.
